devGuidelineLoadHints.reason: Every API implementation needs only the lightweight shared coding conventions.
Load only when the API has queryContracts, SQL dependencies, DB backend APIs, or table evidence.
Load only when Redis, cache, TTL, session cache, or stale-read risk appears in the handoff.
Load only when request fields, required fields, custom validation, or validation response mapping is relevant.
Load only for appsettings, external endpoint, third-party service, or environment config changes.
Load only when the API touches exception handling, logging, or failure disposition.
Load only to describe step-05 UnitTest / IntegrationTest / runtime validation handoff; step 04 must not write test source.
